Your next haul starts here.

An interactive look at logistics on the frontier. All activity stays in this browser.

  1. Find a transfer

    Compare endpoints, cargo, time limits and rewards on the job board.

  2. Claim with collateral

    Connect a demo wallet and reserve a job. Collateral uses the reward asset; it is not a valuation of the cargo.

  3. Collect, deliver, settle

    Follow the simulated lifecycle in My hauls. Delivery starts a dispute window; settlement releases the reward and collateral.

This is a product mockup. Wallets, balances, delivery verification and time passage are simulated. The protocol does not prescribe the travel path.
